description.value: McDonald's is a globally recognized fast-food chain serving burgers, chicken sandwiches, fries, and McCafé beverages. This Richmond location on Sweden Way includes drive-through and takeaway service, making it a quick and convenient calorie stop. It sits in Richmond's industrial Sweden Way corridor, a useful refuelling point for cyclists navigating that part of the city.

The fetched website is the national McDonald's Canada homepage and contains no location-specific content, so only OSM-confirmed amenities can be reported; all others remain null. No phone number is present in the OSM record, so phone contact confirmation is not possible.
